headline: Bears' Caleb Williams leaves on cart after falling on scramble
summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams exited Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings with a right hamstring injury.

headline: Ben Johnson on Caleb Williams: We’ll see how bad it is tomorrow, go from there
summary: In the immediate aftermath of Sunday's loss to the Vikings, Bears head coach Ben Johnson told reporters he's unsure of the severity of Caleb Williams' hamstring injury.

headline: Trey Smack’s OT kick lifts the Packers past the Jets, ending a 6-game skid
summary: — Trey Smack kicked a 26-yard field goal in overtime and the Green Bay Packers overcame a 10-point fourth-quarter deficit and a sloppy, penalty-filled performance to snap a six-game skid with a 20-17 victory over the New York Jets on Sunday.

headline: Ja'Marr Chase scores 2 TDs on passes from Joe Burrow to lead the Bengals past the Texans 20-6
summary: — Joe Burrow threw two touchdown passes to Ja’Marr Chase to lead the Cincinnati Bengals to a 20-6 win over the Houston Texans on Sunday.
